No reservation is needed but ID is mandatory; there is a snack bar and a covered viewing terrace.
Cheques Vacances are accepted.
group: Birthdays, stag/hen parties and company or friends' outings are offered, with quotes online.
Sprint and endurance races are run on the 1,200 m track.
hours: We-Su 10:00-12:30,14:00-18:00; last sign-up 30 min before closing

family: Electric Kid Racers take children aged 3 to 6 on the Mini Kids track.
LR5 karts take children aged 7 to 11 from 1.25 m on the separate Karty track.
The Rotax 2-stroke rental karts require drivers aged 16 and 1.50 m.
group: Group challenges, children's birthday formulas and stag/hen formulas are offered.
Separate pricing exists for companies and associations.
hours: Apr-Oct 10:00-19:00; Nov-Mar 10:00-17:00 (stated as open 7 days, weekends and public holidays; check the track calendar)

family: Children's Fun Karts take drivers from age 7 or 1.25 m.
A driving school runs for ages 7 to 17, and mini motos are also available.
The Rotax competition kart requires manager approval and a 500 EUR card deposit.
group: Karting and the 6-lane bowling in Villeneuve can be privatised for company events, with a seminar room for up to 120 people and catering.
Birthday parties and works-council offers are available.
hours: We, Fr, Sa, Su 09:00-12:00,14:00-19:00; school holidays daily 09:00-13:00,15:00-21:00; Saturday night session until 22:30 (seasonal, see agenda)

family: Solo driving is open from age 14, and children from age 6 can ride as co-pilot in one of two two-seaters.
Families can relax on a terrace or in the club house beside the 1,100 m track.
group: Mini Grand Prix (from 75 EUR) and team Grand Prix challenges are offered, with group and seminar formulas.

family: Funkid junior karts take children aged 7 to 13 from 1.30 m, at 16 EUR per session; children do not ride with adults.
SR4 Sport karts need 1.60 m, with age 13 allowed under conditions.
Paintball and mini motos (18+) are also on site.
group: Children's birthdays (ages 7-13, minimum 6) cost 35 EUR per child; teen birthdays are quoted on request.
Stag/hen parties (60 EUR, min 6) and private race formats (65 EUR, min 8, age 14+) are offered.
Company and after-work events are quoted on request.
hours: Sep 11:00-19:00; Oct-Mar 11:00-18:00; May-Jun 11:00-19:00 (closed Tuesdays); Apr 11:00-18:00, weekends 11:00-19:00; Jul-Aug daily 10:00-19:00, plus Fridays 18:00-22:00
